info.title: SCDEE API
info.description:
Backend API for the **Digital Exam Correction System (SCDEE/B)** — a multi-tenant platform that ingests scanned written exams, drives them through OCR / QR recognition, lets graders annotate and grade them on screen, and publishes the results to students.

This document is intended to be sufficient on its own — every cross-cutting convention is described below; every endpoint documents its specific request/response shape and error codes.

---

## Authentication

All ``/api/v1/*`` endpoints require a JWT bearer token unless noted otherwise. Obtain a token pair from ``POST /api/v1/auth/login/`` and pass the access token as ``Authorization: Bearer <token>``. Tokens are short-lived and rotate via ``POST /api/v1/auth/refresh/`` before they expire.

Public endpoints (no auth required): ``/health/``, ``/api/v1/auth/login/``, ``/api/v1/auth/refresh/``, ``/api/v1/auth/logout/``.

The authenticator is plugin-based (RF-1.1). v1.0 ships only the JWT-by-credentials plugin; SSO plugins are designed for but not implemented in v1.0.

---

## Multi-tenancy

Every business resource is scoped to one **organisation**, a university, an institute, or a SaaS tenant.Listings, lookups, and writes only see resources of the caller's organisation; cross-tenant access returns ``404 NOT_FOUND``.

---

## Error format

All errors follow a uniform JSON shape (RNF-8). The frontend maps ``error_code`` to a localised user-facing message, the API never sends human-readable text on the wire.

Single-code errors (most cases):

```json
{"error_code": "AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED"}
```

Validation errors (HTTP 400 only) carry per-field details:

```json
{
  "error_code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
  "errors": {
    "email": ["FIELD_REQUIRED"],
    "password": ["MIN_LENGTH"]
  }
}
```

The most common error codes:

| Status | ``error_code``              | Meaning                                                 |
|-------:|------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------|
|    400 | ``VALIDATION_ERROR``         | Request body / query string failed serializer validation. |
|    401 | ``AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED``  | Missing, expired or revoked access token.               |
|    403 | ``PERMISSION_DENIED``        | Authenticated, but role does not allow this action.      |
|    404 | ``NOT_FOUND``                | Resource does not exist in this organisation.           |
|    409 | ``CONFLICT``                 | Concurrent modification or invalid state transition.    |
|    429 | ``RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED``      | Throttle exceeded — back off and retry.                 |
|    500 | ``INTERNAL_ERROR``           | Unexpected server error (logged with a trace ID).       |

Endpoint-specific codes (e.g. ``COURSE_ARCHIVED``, ``EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS``, ``PROBLEM_NOT_FOUND``) are documented on each operation's response section.

---

## Pagination

Paginated endpoints use **page-number pagination** (RNF-15). Query parameters: ``page`` (default 1) and ``page_size`` (default 25, max 100). Paginated lists return this envelope; operations may explicitly return an unpaginated array:

```json
{
  "count": 247,
  "page": 1, "page_size": 25, "total_pages": 10,
  "next":  "https://.../?page=2&page_size=25",
  "previous": null,
  "results": [ ... ]
}
```

---

## Rate limiting

All endpoints are throttled (RNF-6). Defaults: anonymous 30/min, regular users 120/min, managers 300/min, login 10/min/IP. Exceeded → ``429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED``.

get.description:
**Return the authenticated user's full profile.**

Includes the *decrypted* DNI — by RF-2.10, the DNI is shown in plaintext only when the caller views their own profile or is an organisation manager. The DNI is stored encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM (RF-16.3) and decrypted only on this code path.

Other endpoints that serialise users (lists, search) do *not* include the DNI.

patch.description:
**Patch a subset of the caller's own profile.**

Two fields are accepted:
- ``email`` (RF-2.9) — new contact address. Must be unique within the organisation.
- ``email_notifications_enabled`` (RF-2.11) — when ``false``, the system stops sending email mirrors of in-app notifications.

**Unchanged fields are silently no-ops.** A request with the same email and same notification preference returns ``200`` without writing to the database (and without an audit row).

**Audit**

Effective changes are logged with ``USER_UPDATED`` and the before/after values, marked ``self_update=true`` (RF-16.1).

get.description: Own active memberships in the authenticated user's organization and active course, without can_manage_members. Includes membership_id and the complete effective_permissions boolean map. No membership, inactive membership/course or no organization returns an empty list. Refetch on session/context changes, permission edits and permission-denied responses; the server always authorizes writes.

get.description: Search engine for Organization Managers to search across courses, subjects, exams and instances with a single endpoint. The level of the hierarchy is determined by the presence of query parameters: `course_id` → list subjects, `subject_id` → list exams, `exam_id` → list instances. Supports text search and filtering on each level.

parameters.description: Course UUID to list subjects

parameters.name: exam_id
parameters.description: Exam UUID to list instances

parameters.name: has_issues
parameters.description: Filter instances with issues

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: Page size

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Text search (label/name/email)

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Instance status filter

parameters.name: subject_id
parameters.description: Subject UUID to list exams

200.description: Paginated list of results. The actual item schema depends on the chosen hierarchy level (courses, subjects, exams, or instances).

BearerAuth.description: JWT access token. Obtain via `POST /api/v1/auth/login/`. Pass as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Access tokens expire after 15 minutes by default; use `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh/` to renew.

UserResponse.description:
Output shape for user data in all responses.

The DNI field is NEVER included here. When needed (own profile,
export), the view adds it explicitly to the response data.
This prevents accidental exposure.

CreateOrganizationRequest.description:
Input for POST /api/v1/organizations/ (RF-2.1).

Creates an organization and its initial manager in one request.
Only accessible by superadmins.

plan.description:
Subscription plan (FREE or PREMIUM).

* `FREE` - Free
* `PREMIUM` - Premium

initial_manager.description: Data for the organization's first manager.

InitialManagerRequest.description: Data for the first manager created with the organization.

OrganizationConflict.description: Safe domain conflicts; nested manager fields use dotted paths.

ProfileResponse.description:
Output for GET /api/v1/profile/ (RF-2.10).

Includes all personal data visible to the user, including
their own decrypted DNI. Subject memberships will be added
in Fase 3 when SubjectMembership is implemented.

dni.description: Decrypted DNI. Only visible to the user themselves and managers.

PatchedUpdateProfileRequest.description:
Input for PATCH /api/v1/profile/ (RF-2.9, RF-2.11).

Users can only modify:
- email: their own email address (RF-2.9)
- email_notifications_enabled: notification preference (RF-2.11)

All other fields (name, NIA, is_staff, etc.) are managed by
the organization manager via PATCH /users/{id}/.

email.description: New email address. Must be unique within the organization.

effective_permissions.description: Complete boolean permission map, including explicit revocations. Resolved from organization defaults and membership overrides on each request; staff bypass grants all keys. Missing or unknown keys must be treated as false.

notification_ids.description: Specific IDs to mark. Empty = mark all.
